versions.changelog:
- Updated documentation to add a "Start on APIDot" section with clear entry points for Gemini 3.
- Improved guidance for users coming from ClawHub.
- Removed the file skill-card.md; documentation is now consolidated in SKILL.md.
- No functional changes; this version is still documentation-only with no executable code or automation.

- Added references/api.md with non-executable notes for Gemini 3 routing and integration guidance.
- Removed skill-card.md to clean up non-essential files.
- Updated SKILL.md to reference the new notes file and clarify included content.
- No changes to API functionality; remains documentation-only.
- Expanded guidance on using local reference notes for Gemini 3 workflows.

Initial release of documentation-only skill for APIDot Gemini 3 API integration.

- Provides detailed guidance for building workflows using Gemini 3 models via APIDot.
- Includes API key security best practices and integration tips.
- Explains when and how to use Gemini 3 Flash Preview, Pro Preview, chat, coding assistants, and streaming.
- Links to official APIDot documentation, model pages, and example resources.
- Does not include executable code, scripts, or automation—documentation only.
